title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Scientific Code Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2609.12190v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models have become central to modern coding assistants, but state-of-the-art systems such as Claude Code or Codex rely on very large, cloud-hosted models with significant computational cost and data-privacy implications. This work investigates whether a useful, fully local coding agent can be built around small open-source models by shifting the computational burden away from inference. We develop a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system for scientific code understanding that strictly separates an expensive offline ingestion stage parsing, structural graph construction, LLM-generated entity explanations, and embedding from a lightweight online answering stage. translated_title: 面向科学代码理解的检索增强生成
translated_abstract: 大语言模型已成为现代编程助手的核心，但诸如Claude Code或Codex等最先进的系统依赖于非常庞大的云端托管模型，带来了显著的计算成本和数据隐私方面的问题。本工作研究是否可以通过将计算负担从推理阶段转移开，围绕小型开源模型构建一个实用的、完全本地的编程智能体。我们开发了一个用于科学代码理解的检索增强生成（RAG）系统，该系统严格地将昂贵的离线摄取阶段（解析、结构图构建、LLM生成的实体解释和嵌入）与轻量级的在线问答阶段分离开来。该系统在一个包含100个问题、横跨11个类别的基准测试上进行评估，测试对象是用C++编写的IPPL科学代码库，答案由一个独立的前沿模型作为评判者进行评分。在七个回答模型中，我们发现模型家族和检索（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种将昂贵的离线处理阶段（解析、结构图构建、实体解释和嵌入）与轻量级在线问答阶段严格分离的检索增强生成系统，使小型开源模型能够在完全本地环境下有效理解科学代码，从而在降低计算成本和保护数据隐私的同时构建实用的编程智能体。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Retrieval-Augmented Generation system that strictly separates an expensive offline ingestion stage from a lightweight online answering stage, enabling small open-source models to effectively understand scientific code in a fully local setting, thus building a practical coding agent while reducing computational costs and protecting data privacy.
